prompt.initial:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: single finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, PNG, landscape 1792 x 1024 or 1920 x 1080 (approximately 16:9, width over 1000px).
Primary request: Create one original finished thumbnail for バスケまとめ for the frozen article dated 2026-11-20 about daily game results and position-specific EFF top three. All typography and illustration must be generated together.

Style/medium: bold hand-painted sports editorial ink illustration, visible dry-brush hatching and graphic silhouette. Base near-black #151A18, fluorescent lime #CCF43B, warm ivory lettering and skin highlights, a single orange basketball. Match the inspected black/lime approved reference's bold Japanese sans-serif headline, sparse composition, diagonal ink strokes, high contrast. Do NOT copy its player, text, score, shooting pose, or date. Strictly illustration, not photorealistic, no photographic face or pasted photo.

Subject: ONE real player, Ryusei Abe (阿部 龍星), selected randomly from the article's named players. His official Yamagata Wyverns / B.LEAGUE 2026-27 portrait has been visually inspected. Preserve these actual features: young adult Japanese male basketball guard, lean athletic frame, light warm skin, clean-shaven, medium-short voluminous chestnut/dark brown hair with tousled wavy layered locks and a loose off-center part; visible forehead center, hair slightly over temples, dark almond-shaped eyes with subtly hooded lids, straight natural eyebrows, oval face narrowing into a rounded chin, moderately long straight nose, defined closed lips, slightly prominent ears. No beard, no mustache, no headband, no buzz cut. Maintain his recognizable facial proportions in expressive ink drawing, without exaggeration. Plain dark purple basketball jersey and shorts with slim yellow edging rendered primarily in monochrome ink; NO jersey letters, numbers, team marks, sponsors or logos.

Scene/composition: Dynamic original conceptual illustration of Abe driving with the ball, three-quarter body on the right 43% of the frame, knees bent, torso leaning forward, face turned enough toward the viewer to recognize, looking forward. His hand is touching/controlling an orange basketball at hip-to-thigh level in a low dribble; other arm naturally bent for balance. Two arms, anatomically clear hands and separated natural fingers; no extra fingers, extra limbs, or duplicate basketball. Both hands and the ball fully visible with comfortable edge clearance. Figure may finish around thighs near lower edge but do not sever fingers or ball. Use diagonal lime brush speed strokes behind him and small ink splashes, no literal stadium, no opponent, no hoop necessary. This is an imagined basketball pose, not a reconstruction of a specific game or scoring event.

Layout: left 54% reserved for exact text on clean black. Top left small publication line. Below it medium-large date/results line. Main headline is 当日のEFF in huge warm ivory, and ポジション別TOP3 in lime on the next line, both kept completely within safe margins and not touching the figure. Readable bold Japanese gothic typography; the word ポジション別 must stay clearly readable because rankings are by position, not an overall ranking. Bottom left two separate readable annotations. Keep safe margins of at least 5% on all text. Do not let lime marks interfere with text. No tables, card symbols, statistics, scores, names, labels on clothing, extra words or decorative pseudo-text.

Text (verbatim), exactly these six strings:
"バスケまとめ"
"11/20 試合結果"
"当日のEFF"
"ポジション別TOP3"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Constraints: selected player is purely an illustrative subject. Never write his name, team, points, rank, performance, appearance or any personal claim on the image. No real-game reenactment or victory celebration. No team or league logos, sponsor lettering, watermarks, official photography, copied reference photo. The only content facts shown are 11/20, game results, daily EFF and position-specific TOP3, supported by the supplied frozen manuscript. Do not add claims from external sources. One polished image only.
prompt.revision:
Use case: identity-preserve
Edit target: Image 1 is the generated black/lime basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is the official portrait of real player Ryusei Abe (阿部 龍星), supplied solely for facial identity reference. Modify ONLY the illustrated player and his basketball plus the immediate background around him. Keep all six Japanese text strings, their typography, wording, color, hierarchy, placement, and the overall dark #151A18 / lime #CCF43B brush design exactly unchanged. Keep canvas approximately 16:9 at least 1000 px wide.

Correction: Redraw the same driving/dribbling figure about 12% smaller and slightly inward within the right side so the entire hair silhouette has at least 35px of black clearance above, both hands and all fingertips are completely visible, and the entire ball has at least 40px clearance above the bottom edge. His waist/thighs may meet the lower image edge, but his head, hands, and ball must not touch or cross any edge. Keep the same two-arm pose and one ball.

Identity: Refer closely to the actual face and hair of Image 2, then translate those proportions into the same hand-drawn ink/brush illustration medium of Image 1. Do not paste or photorealistically reproduce the photo. The first drawing has too much voluminous curly hair, thicker eyebrows and an overly sculpted model-like face. Match the reference's shorter slightly tousled chestnut brown layered hair, flatter loose off-center part, visible central forehead, naturally finer straight brows, subtly hooded dark eyes, oval longer midface, softly rounded narrower chin, natural closed mouth and slightly prominent ears. Absolutely no facial hair. Retain an athletic guard's physique. Jersey remains plain purple/yellow with NO letters, numbers, sponsors, club or league logos.

Exact text to preserve:
バスケまとめ
11/20 試合結果
当日のEFF
ポジション別TOP3
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

This remains a conceptual illustration of a randomly selected real player, not a recreation of a game. No player name or personal performance text. One corrected finished PNG only.

generator.qa_method: 生成画像を実見。初稿の人物とボールの端の余白、髪型・顔立ちを1回修正。修正版の全6文字列、11/20とTOP3、当日・ポジション別の限定、公式写真との容姿、人物・両手・指・ボールの見切れ、ロゴなし、AI表記を目視確認。
